::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 19  [1894]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e.174 ff 167-8
:::

Dear [Mr Bullock](people/person_221.qmd),
I send you Bishop Frampton with your list, and many thanks for it, I hope you have the life of [Fletcher](people/person_1677.qmd) of Madeley that shews how much braver he was than two soldier brothers.[^1] Your [Mother](people/person_2134.qmd) may be interested to hear that [Heartsease](cmy_books/cmybook_19.qmd) was the last book [Lord Raglan](people/person_1276.qmd) read.

[Sir Eustace Stewart](people/person_1277.qmd) who lent it to him told me

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Rev. John William Fletcher (1729-1785), vicar of Madeley, Shropshire and friend of John Wesley;  he came from a Swiss military family.  The book was probably *Wesley’s Designated Successor: The Life, Letters and Literary Labours of the Rev. John William Fletcher, Vicar of Madeley* (London: Hodder 1882).  CMY had written the life of Robert Frampton (1622-1708), Bishop of Gloucester for the 'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans' series which was part of Bullock's *Daily Lections* project.
